node_labels.u0: The agent has not opened the locked door guarding the target room, so the prohibition is still intact. The requirement is to keep that door shut for the rest of the episode; locating the key, carrying it, or entering the target room are not needed here, and no completion state exists for this rule-only task.
node_labels.u1: The agent opened the locked door guarding the target room, breaking the mandatory requirement. This is an irreversible failure: successful completion of the task is no longer possible.

node_labels.u0: The task has just begun: the agent must reach the exit while carrying the box, and any time the box slips from its hands, the very next step must pick it up again. If the agent arrives at the exit holding the box (and the box does not fall on that step), the requirements are satisfied. If the box falls, the agent enters a one-step obligation to pick it up immediately; if the agent reaches the exit without the box, it will still need to pick the box up before the exit condition can pay off.
node_labels.u1: The box has just fallen out of the agent's hands this step, so the promise is active: the very next step must pick it up again. Picking it up on the next step returns the agent to normal progress toward the exit. Any next step that does not leave the agent holding the box — moving, turning, or reaching the exit empty-handed — breaks the requirement and fails the task, while a fall on the next step with empty hands also fails.
node_labels.u2: The agent is standing on the exit but not carrying the box, and the box did not fall on this step. To finish successfully, the agent must now pick the box up (or otherwise come to hold it) while still at the exit. If the box falls before it is held, the agent enters the pick-up obligation; if it picks the box up, the task is satisfied.
node_labels.u3: The task is complete: the agent has reached the exit while holding the box, and no fall occurred on the final step. The requirement to keep the box in hand until the exit has been met.
node_labels.u4: The agent is at the exit and the box fell on this same step, leaving its hands empty. This is a failing situation for the exit condition, so the agent must recover by picking the box up next; if it does not hold the box on the following step, the task fails. Picking the box up on the next step allows the agent to reach the exit holding it.
node_labels.u5: The agent is at the exit while the box just fell from its hands on this step, so the immediate pick-up obligation is in force. The agent must pick the box up on the very next step; failing to hold it then means the task fails. If it does pick the box up on the next step, the requirement at the exit is met and the task succeeds.
node_labels.u6: A mandatory requirement has been broken: the box fell and the agent did not pick it up on the very next step (it either was not holding the box, or reached the exit or moved on without it). Successful completion is no longer possible for this episode.

card.task: Carry the box to the exit. Each time the box falls, your very next move must pick it up again.

node_labels.u0: Nothing has been required or broken yet: the exit has not been reached and no fall has gone unanswered. The goal remains to reach the exit while holding the box, picking it up again immediately on any step in which it slips out of the hands.
node_labels.u1: The agent is carrying the box and no recent fall is waiting for an immediate re-pickup. The remaining objective is to arrive at the exit still carrying the box, and if the box falls the agent must pick it up on the very next step.
node_labels.u2: The box has just slipped out of the agent's hands and is not being carried. It must be picked up on the very next step, otherwise the requirement is broken for good; after recovering it, the agent still needs to reach the exit holding the box.
node_labels.u3: A box fall occurred at the same time the agent was carrying it, so the immediate re-pickup obligation remains open. The agent must be holding the box on the next step and then reach the exit with it; failing to hold it on that step ends the task in failure.
node_labels.u4: The agent has reached the exit but is not carrying the box, so the through-the-episode requirement that the box be held at some point is still pending. It must carry the box while the episode continues, and if the box slips it must pick it up on the very next step.
node_labels.u5: The exit has been reached while the box was in the agent's hands, so both the requirement to reach the exit and the requirement to hold the box are satisfied. The task is complete.
node_labels.u6: The agent is at the exit without the box, and a box fall happened on that same step. The immediate re-pickup obligation is still open, so the box must be in hand on the next step, and the episode's requirement to have held the box must still be met.
node_labels.u7: The agent is at the exit while carrying the box, having just recovered from a fall. The fall has been answered immediately as required, the box is in hand at the exit, and holding it again on the next step would keep the task satisfied.
node_labels.u8: A required obligation has been irreversibly broken: after a box fall the agent failed to have the box back in hand on the very next step, or reached the exit without ever satisfying the box requirement. Successful completion is no longer possible.

card.task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

node_labels.u0: The task has not yet been completed and the door is still closed, so the agent may still pick up the key, unlock the door, and retrieve the target box. The requirement is to eventually pick up the designated box, and this must be achieved without opening the door if the key has already been dropped while the door was closed. Progress means acquiring the key and opening the door only while still holding it, then dropping the key with the door open and picking up the box.
node_labels.u1: The target box has been picked up successfully, satisfying the main goal while the door remained closed throughout. The mandatory requirements are met and the task is complete.
node_labels.u2: A mandatory requirement has been violated: the door was opened, which is forbidden once the key has been lost while the door was still closed (or the door was opened without the key being retained as required). Successful completion is no longer possible from this state.

card.task: Pick up the box in the other room, but never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

node_labels.u0: Nothing required for the mission has been accomplished yet: the ball is still blocking the doorway, the matching key is not held, the door is closed, and the target box is not picked up. The agent must first move the ball away, then take the matching key, then open the door, and finally pick up the designated box. Taking the key before the ball has been cleared, or otherwise breaking the required order, permanently fails the attempt.
node_labels.u1: A mandatory ordering requirement has been violated, so the mission can no longer succeed. This occurs when progress is made out of order, such as taking the key before clearing the ball, opening the door before the earlier prerequisites, or grabbing the target box too early. The task is irreversibly failed.
node_labels.u2: The blocking ball has been moved away from the door at least once, satisfying the first ordering condition, but the door is still closed, no matching key is currently held, and the target box has not been picked up. The remaining work is to obtain the matching key, use it to open the door, and then collect the designated box. If the ball has since been put back in front of the door, it must be moved away again before the door can be opened.
node_labels.u3: The blocking ball has been moved away from the door at least once, and the matching key has been picked up at least once, but the door is still closed and the target box is not yet held. Before the door can be opened, the matching key must be currently carried and the doorway must be clear; if the key was dropped or the ball was put back, that condition must be restored first. After the door is open, the remaining objective is to get through and pick up the designated box.
node_labels.u4: The ordered milestones have been achieved: the ball was moved, the matching key was acquired, and the door was opened, so all prerequisites for the box are complete. The only remaining objective is to pick up the designated target box. If the key is still being carried, it must be put down first to free the agent's hand. If the door has been closed again, it must be reopened to regain access to the box room.
node_labels.u5: The designated target box has been picked up, so the mission is complete and the episode ends successfully. All required orderings were satisfied: the ball was cleared before the key was taken, the key was acquired before the door was opened, and the door was opened before the box was collected. No further action is needed.

card.task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box.

node_labels.u0: The episode has just begun: the exit has not been reached and the switch has not yet been flipped. To succeed, the agent must flip the switch at some point and then reach the exit; reaching the exit without having flipped the switch first fails the task. Flipping the switch before reaching the exit advances progress, and afterwards the only remaining objective is to reach the exit.
node_labels.u1: The switch has been flipped at least once, so the precondition for a valid exit is met. The remaining objective is to reach the exit while this history is preserved. Waiting or roaming is allowed as long as the agent eventually reaches the exit.
node_labels.u2: The agent reached the exit without having flipped the switch first, which violates the mandatory ordering requirement. Successful completion is no longer possible, and the episode ends in failure.
node_labels.u3: The agent has flipped the switch and then reached the exit, so both requirements are satisfied: the switch was toggled before arrival and the exit was reached. The task is complete and the episode ends successfully.

card.task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

node_labels.u0: The episode is in its early stage: the key has not yet been dropped while the door is shut, and the door has never been opened. The agent must still open the door and then reach the goal, and it may pick up the key with no penalty. Dropping the key before the door has been opened would violate the requirement and end in failure, so the key must be kept in hand until the door is unlocked.
node_labels.u1: This is a failure state: the key was dropped while the door was closed, which violated the requirement that the door be opened before the key is let go. Successful completion is no longer possible, since the mandatory ordering has been broken for good.
node_labels.u2: The door has been opened, so the key may now be dropped without penalty and the ordering requirement is satisfied. The remaining objective is to reach the green goal; once there, the task completes successfully.
node_labels.u3: All requirements are satisfied: the door was opened before any dropping of the key, and the agent now stands on the goal. The task is complete.

card.task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

node_labels.u0: The episode has just begun: the key has not been located, the locked door is still closed, and the ball has not been picked up. The objectives remain to locate the matching key, then open the locked door with it, and finally pick up the target ball, always opening the door before the pickup. Picking up the ball now without having opened the locked door would fail the task, and finding the key creates an obligation to eventually open the locked door.
node_labels.u1: A mandatory requirement has been violated: either the ball was picked up without the locked door ever being opened, or the key was found but the ball was taken without first opening the door. Successful completion is no longer possible and the episode is failed.
node_labels.u2: The locked door has been opened, satisfying the obligation to open it after any key discovery, though the ball has not yet been picked up. The remaining objective is to enter the target room and pick up the designated ball. Until the pickup happens, the agent may drop the key and shut the door again, and it must be reopened before any pickup.
node_labels.u3: The task requirements have been satisfied: the locked door was opened before the ball, any found key was followed by opening the door, and the mission's target ball has been picked up. The episode is complete.
node_labels.u4: The matching key has been located but the locked door has not yet been opened, and the ball has not been picked up. Two obligations remain: open the locked door with the matching key, and then pick up the target ball. The agent must retrieve and carry the key to the door, and must not pick up the ball before the door has been opened.

card.task: If you find the key, you must also open the locked door. Then pick up the ball.

node_labels.u0: The episode is just beginning and nothing has been established yet: the key has not been located, the locked door is closed, and the ball has not been picked up. The agent must eventually open the locked door (which requires finding and carrying the matching key first) and then pick up the mission's ball, with the door left open on the final step. Picking up the ball before the door has ever been opened, or after the key has been sighted while the door is shut, ruins the mission.
node_labels.u1: A mandatory requirement has been violated: the ball was picked up while the locked door had not been opened after the key had been located, breaking the promise that the door be open on the final step. Successful completion is no longer possible for this episode.
node_labels.u2: The locked door is currently open, which satisfies the requirement to open it at least once. The remaining work is to pick up the mission's ball, and if the key has already been found the door must still be open when the episode ends, so it must not be shut again before the ball is collected. From here the agent may proceed to the pickup, or may still locate the key if it has not yet been seen, keeping the door open along the way.
node_labels.u3: The mission's ball has been picked up with the locked door open, so every requirement is satisfied and the episode completes successfully. No further action is needed.
node_labels.u4: The matching key has been located but the locked door is still closed and the ball has not been picked up. The agent must obtain the matching key, use it to open the locked door before the end of the episode, and then pick up the ball, keeping the door open on the final step. Picking up the ball while the door remains shut at the end would fail the mission.
node_labels.u5: The key has been located and the door was opened once, but the door is now shut again and the ball has not yet been picked up. The agent must reopen the locked door and leave it open on the final step, then pick up the ball. Opening the door again is also possible while the agent is still empty-handed, but picking up the ball while the door stays closed until the end would fail the mission.
node_labels.u6: The ball has been picked up but the locked door is currently closed, while the key has already been found. The agent must reopen the locked door before the episode ends, since a successful finish requires the door to be open on the final step with the ball collected.

card.task: Whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards. Pick up the key, open the door with it, then pick up the box in the other room.
